How I work

Three things I don’t compromise on.

I start with your actual content.

Not a theme demo. The site gets built around what your business really says and sells.

I build the system, not just the page.

Custom fields and post types so you can add content later without breaking the design.

I’d rather send you the file than book a call.

Send me the brief, I’ll send back assets and a clear next step. No scheduling required.

FAQ

Before you message me.

What platforms do you build on?

Mostly Wix Studio and WordPress with Elementor Pro, depending on what the brief actually needs. I’ll tell you which fits before we start, not after.

Do you only build new sites, or fix existing ones too?

Both. A lot of my work is rebuilding or untangling a site that’s already live: broken layouts, missing structure, content that’s outgrown the template.

Do we need to schedule a call?

Not usually. Send me your brief and any existing brand assets in writing, and I’ll come back with a clear plan. It’s faster for both of us. Happy to hop on a call if it’s genuinely needed.

Do you offer support after the site is live?

Yes. Happy to handle edits, content updates, or small fixes after launch. We can figure out what that looks like for your site.

Got a brief?

Tell me what the site needs to do, and I’ll tell you exactly how I’d build it.
